description: Use report_video for Highlights: generate one retained MP4 from the studies' default reports, with branded logo bookends, learning-goal chapters and their cited Quotes. Repeated requests return the saved video. No evidence selection is needed. Also supports an editable PowerPoint, an individual audio clip or a legacy audio reel ZIP from a completed/partial research analysis run. Use exact evidence_ids returned by get_research_analysis highlights; presentations include all findings. Audio requires explicit export instruction. Text masking defaults on. Poll get_research_deliverable, or wait on the MCP background task when the client supports tasks. Private links last 15 minutes; temporary audio and presentation files expire in seven days; report videos are retained while their source remains available. Reuse the idempotency key after a timeout.

acknowledge_unredacted_audio.description: True only when the researcher has instructed you to export these recordings. Speech is not anonymized.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence identifiers to include in the deliverable, in the requested order.

idempotency_key.description: Use a stable key for this operation and reuse it on retries with the same inputs.

kind.description: Type of research deliverable to generate.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

padding_seconds.description: Seconds of audio to include around each selected excerpt.

redact_pii.description: Request redaction of personal information in the generated artifact.

run_id.description: Identifier of a research analysis run.

title.description: Display title for the generated deliverable.
